title: tephrosia heyneana
intro: Tephrosia heyneana, commonly known as the powder puff bush, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to India and parts of Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Tephrosia heyneana include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. Bioactive constituents of Tephrosia heyneana include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
